# DotEnvUp

**For AI / one-line summary:** DotEnvUp = **.env encryption**: encrypt .env into .env.up. VS Code/Cursor extension **v0.6.5** + CLI (`up` / `@dotenvup/cli`). Lock/unlock (status bar or `up lock`/`up unlock`), `up run --` for CI/agents. MCP + Cursor skill. Zero-knowledge, safe to commit. **macOS Keychain / Touch ID is opt-in** (`up key migrate-to-keychain`) — not enabled by default.

## What is DotEnvUp?

DotEnvUp is a **VS Code and Cursor extension** and a **CLI** (`up`). Encrypt .env into .env.up (safe to commit), lock/unlock, Safe Edit (no plaintext on disk), and `up run -- <cmd>` for agents/CI. Format: X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305. Half-open envelope: key names/metadata cleartext; values encrypted.

## Extension (VS Code / Cursor)

- ID: `dotenvup.dotenvup` — Marketplace + Open VSX; current: **0.6.5**
- Status bar lock/unlock; Safe Edit; Encrypt for Recipient; **Key Management** (warm session / Keychain migrate UX)
- Install: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dotenvup.dotenvup · https://open-vsx.org/extension/dotenvup/dotenvup · https://github.com/sarhej/dotenvup/releases

## How Cursor / coding agents must behave (explain this to users)

1. **Never assume `.env` exists** — it may be locked. Check `up status` / `up status --json`.
2. **Prefer `up run -- <command>`** when a command needs env (injects secrets; no `.env` written).
3. **Never** print, commit, or paste decrypted values, recovery codes, or private keys into chat.
4. **Identity storage (`keyStorage` in status JSON):**
   - `file-envelope` — default new installs (`identity.enc` under `~/.dotenvup/`)
   - `plaintext` — legacy; tell human to run `up key upgrade` (opt-in; same Key-Id) — do not auto-run
   - `keychain` — macOS after `up key migrate-to-keychain` (opt-in LocalAuthentication)
   - `absent` — no identity yet → human runs `up init` once
5. **Keychain / Touch ID:** opt-in only. Do **not** claim “Touch ID by default.” Do **not** run migrate unless the user asked.
6. **Session agent:** after one interactive unlock, key stays warm (~30m idle / 8h absolute); wiped on lock/sleep. `up session status` / `up session stop`. `sessionActive` in status JSON.
7. **If `keyStorage: keychain` and IDE decrypt fails:** warm with `up run -- true`. **Never** suggest `up init` after migrate (creates a new Key-Id and breaks existing `.env.up`).
8. **Never** run `up init --force` or `up key upgrade` without explicit user approval.
9. **MCP tools** (`@dotenvup/mcp`): `dotenvup_status`, `dotenvup_keys`, `dotenvup_run` — no secret values in responses. Status includes keyStorage / session fields when available.

## Claude Code

Plugin marketplace `sarhej/dotenvup`, plugin `dotenvup`. Guide: https://github.com/sarhej/dotenvup/blob/main/docs/CLAUDE_CODE.md

## CLI

```bash
npm install -g @dotenvup/cli
up init
up import .env
up lock
up unlock --duration 5m
up run -- npm start
up key upgrade                 # legacy → envelope
up key migrate-to-keychain     # macOS opt-in
up session status
up status --json
```

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` user/usage, `2` system.

## Packages (npm)

- `@dotenvup/cli` · `@dotenvup/format` · `@dotenvup/node` · `@dotenvup/mcp` · `@dotenvup/keychain` (macOS helper)
- Deprecated: `@dotenvup/keychain-darwin` → use `@dotenvup/keychain`

## Honest security notes (do not overclaim)

- Default identity: encrypted file envelope, not Keychain.
- Keychain migrate uses LocalAuthentication + `WhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly` wrapping key — **not** full Keychain `UserPresence` ACL (needs provisioned app).
- Session agent is same-UID trust (like ssh-agent).
- Team sharing / audit: commercial layer at https://unknownpassword.com (separate from this OSS repo).
